incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: serving-runtime-prod p95 latency > 1200ms for 5m (pd/INC-81234)

ravi-oncall: acked oncall (taking) :wave:

sre-lee: on it — looking at p95/p99 dashboards now. any recent deploys?

infra-ana: no deploys in last 30m, autoscaler shows spike in queue depth + new node spinups failing with OOM on tokenizer sidecar

eng-maria: seeing KV cache evictions in logs around the same time, maybe hotkeys. tail shows many heavy prompt lengths (>=2048) to /v1/chat.generate

ravi-oncall: ok triage plan: 1) fallback routing to small-templates model variant 2) increase tokenization parallelism to avoid tokenizer OOMs 3) throttle noisy clients via rate-limit rules

sre-lee: running quick rollback of tokenizer sidecar memory bump to 6G on a canary host, will watch for drop in OOMs — command: `kubectl patch ds tokenizer-sidecar -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"tokenizer","resources":{"limits":{"memory":"6Gi"}}}]}}}}'`

infra-ana: autoscaler logs: "scale up failed: pod evicted due to memorypressure" — provisioning new instance types as fallback (g5 -> a100 spot fallback)

pm-jordan: customer impact? any errors surfaced in gateway? need an external status update if >30m

cs-sam: I can draft a brief: "We are experiencing degraded response times for text generation affecting some requests. Engineers are investigating and applying mitigations." happy to post to status.redwood.ai if you confirm

ravi-oncall: set PD note to "mitigations in progress: canary memory bump + fallback routing" — leaving page open for now

sre-lee: canary memory bump applied, tokenizer OOMs reduced on host-7, p95 dropped from 1.3s -> 650ms on that shard :tada:

eng-maria: enabling fallback routing now: switching route weight 70% -> stable-small-templates variant (CLI): `redwood route set-weight serving-runtime-prod stable-small-templates=0.7`

infra-ana: autoscaler now successfully provisioning fallback nodepool, pods healthy

ravi-oncall: good progress — monitor for 15m then re-evaluate. @cs-sam queue a short status page update (we'll iterate after 15m)

cs-sam: posting initial status now. will update after 15m check-in

pm-jordan: thanks team. any signal on error rates or customer 5xxs?

eng-maria: 5xxs up 0.6% peak, mostly 502s from tokenizer timeouts. expected to drop as canary ramps and routing switches in

sre-lee: keeping pager open until p95 < 700ms cluster-wide for two consecutive 5m windows

ravi-oncall: noted. I'm on-call until 0300 UTC, ping me for any regressions. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: PagerDuty note updated: "Mitigations applied: tokenizer memory bump + route fallback. Monitoring p95 and queue depth."
